Pico thin adapter (LAW-NO-SELF-BUILD):
- Do not rewrite the plan engine.
- Tool name lists are remapped onto the Pico gateway allowlist
  (upstream lists coding-agent builtins read/bash/edit/write).
- RPC has no TUI theme; updateStatus falls back to plain text.
- Extraction, [DONE:n], persistence, --plan flag, /plan remain upstream.
